method.advance: Recover three new useful locations across at least two editor families with at most two additional ordinary photos and at most two extra misplaced edited-file highlights.
method.baseline: Replay the app's original canvas and horizontal reflection. Preserve an original component if at least half of its grid cells recur.
method.reflected_proposal: Keep the existing result. When neither original component survives horizontal support, look for a pair of horizontally and vertically reflected components with at least half of each component in agreement. Propose only their intersection, with the original image reliability mask.
method.sources: Replay all 108 exact PNGs, 28 photos and four editor families in the earlier horizontal-repeat study.
method.useful: At least half the known changed pixels and at least 0.30 intersection over union on the native image.
method.vertical_corroboration: Retain any original component supported at the existing half-component point in either reflection.
